scope: First-party code maintenance, learning continuity, persistence, runtime liveness, deterministic regression fixtures and local production deployment.

source.algorithm: sha256 of sorted path + NUL + file sha256 + newline; source/config/curriculum, docs and generated artifacts excluded

findingsResolved: Continuation families consume one formal learning visit; repeated deaths, late ancestor results and replacement attempts release already-served work without deleting history.
Late evidence cannot reopen newer repaired facets or overwrite a later contradiction. Raw receipts remain retained.
Assessment and native generation retries retain exact captured payloads and provider identity. Late tutor/group/assessment replies must still belong to the same study, learner and task.
Pending assessment requests are saved before response/restart waits; imported runs reset completion scanning; archived interrupted jobs recover consistently.
Durable checkpoints coalesce to one active and one newest waiting write, settle superseded callers and prevent older fallback writes from replacing newer local progress.

Knowledge gaps use scoped IDs and complete normalized descriptions, including operators. Withdrawn resolutions reopen gaps or retain an independently valid resolution; saved derived flags reconcile from retained observations.
Idle handoff polls avoid full private-queue clones, awaited old requests survive pruning, and oversized terminal evidence stays retrievable through exact-turn context parts.
Test Lab capture preserves keys, credentials, force fields and directional quotas using the typed schema and deterministic TestRunner regression.
Long histories avoid argument-spread stack failures. Event processing scans new completions and the newest feed entries without rewriting unchanged DOM.

Browser compilation releases its background service on success and failure before Chrome starts. Private sandbox verification closes before learner renderer allocation; all original namespace/seccomp checks remain mandatory.
Smoke report scripts import their write dependency; production serving has dedicated static-path, proxy, host-validation and unavailable-bridge coverage.

Container workspace fixtures use their intended legacy layout and real opening grace. Stair travel observes outer-well entry on animation frames. Shared-chat setup clears retained motion and claims a real seat, with a deterministic stale-vault regression.

browserStartupEvidence.rootCause: The retained compiler service caused memory-limit reclaim during Chrome bootstrap; the private renderer could not execute its verification predicate.
browserStartupEvidence.scope: This comparison establishes the retained-compiler resource defect; it does not assign one exclusive cause to all historical startup failures.

production.preservation: Existing browser origin, learner save keys, bridge queue identities, OAuth link and sharing preferences.

boundaries: One core and one live-connector browser check are intentionally skipped.
Human gameplay acceptance and external AI semantic/native-identity certification remain the previously documented product boundaries.
